3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Amlodipine 5 mg tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack (Alu/Alu blister).

All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 36 months is proposed when the product is stored below 30 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

Table 1. Storage conditions and duration of data

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 30 C / 65% RH | 30 | 65 | 24 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

The long-term study was stored at 30 C / 65% RH. 24 months of long-term data are available for all three batches.

Assay, related substances and dissolution met the acceptance criteria at every time point.

3.2.P.8.2 Post-approval stability commitment and protocol

The applicant commits to continue the long-term study on the three primary batches up to the end of the proposed shelf life, and to place one production batch of Amlodipine 5 mg tablets per year on stability.

The protocol will be updated if a storage condition or a test method changes.

[Synthetic sample document for software testing.]

4.2 Nonclinical overview

The active substance of Amlodipine 5 mg tablets (synthetic) is the same as that of the reference medicinal product, which has a long record of use. No new nonclinical studies were performed for this application. The overview refers to the published literature on the pharmacology and toxicology of the active substance.

[Synthetic sample document for software testing.]

5.3.1 Bioequivalence study report (summary)

A single-dose, two-period crossover study in healthy adult volunteers compared Amlodipine 5 mg tablets (synthetic) with the reference medicinal product under fasting conditions. The 90% confidence intervals for the ratio of the geometric means of AUC and Cmax fell within the acceptance range of 80.00% to 125.00%.

[Synthetic sample document for software testing.]
